chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim and Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṭalḥah, from Ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام gave judgment regarding a wall in whose demolition three men participated. It fell upon one of them and he died, so he held the remaining two liable for his blood money, because each one of them is liable for his companion.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in his capacity as rightful judicial authority
key_terms.قَضَى: gave a legal judgment or judicial ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if several people jointly demolish a wall and it kills one of them?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning shared liability in a fatal accident during a joint act. It establishes that when multiple participants are jointly involved in a destructive act that causes one of them to die, the surviving participants bear responsibility for the diyah.
